caption: Fig. X. Learning progression and deterministic evaluation of Monolithic PPO. (a) Deterministic task success at 0.35 m/s as a function of environment interactions for Stage 2, Stage 3, and the Stage 4 held out obstacle layout. The observed curriculum mastery transitions were at 14.868M, 15.188M, and 42.394M interactions; for clarity, only 42.394M is marked in panel (a), without implying a causal relationship. The marker at 24.576M shows the proposed method at the same task-specific interaction budget: 12.288M Avoid pretraining plus a 12.288M complete arbitration training-and-selection budget. (b) Strict task success on the same Stage 4 held out obstacle layout across target speeds for Mono checkpoints trained with 24.576M, 49.152M, and 61.440M interactions, together with the proposed method. The 0.60 m/s condition is 20% above training range. Mono curves summarize one training seed; every error bar is the sample SD across three deterministic evaluation seeds. Mono and the proposed method use independent evaluation seed sets and are not episode-paired comparisons.
